legend: The Lost Colony of Roanoke (North Carolina, USA, 1587-1590)
lines: Roanoke Island, August 1590. A ship drops anchor off a silent shore.
Governor John White has been away for three years.
He left more than one hundred settlers behind, including his own family.
He walks up the beach, calling their names. Nobody answers.
The houses are gone, and the fort stands empty.
Then he sees one word carved into a post: Croatoan.
There was no cross, the secret sign they had agreed on for danger.
A storm drove him away, and he never saw them again.
Maybe they joined a friendly tribe. Nobody knows.
What do you think happened to them?
title: Over 100 Settlers Vanished. One Word Was Left Behind... #shorts
description:
In 1590, Governor John White returned to Roanoke Island and found his colony empty, with one word carved into a post: Croatoan. What happened to the settlers is still a mystery.
